استقصصت (form X)
# اِسْتَقْصَصْتُ (istaqṣaṣtu) /is.taq.sˤasˤ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَقَصَّ (istaqaṣṣa)
# اِسْتَقْصَصْتَ (istaqṣaṣta) /is.taq.sˤasˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَقَصَّ (istaqaṣṣa)
# اِسْتَقْصَصْتِ (istaqṣaṣti) /is.taq.sˤasˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَقَصَّ (istaqaṣṣa)
# اُسْتُقْصِصْتُ (ustuqṣiṣtu) /u
